scope: Ordinary functional responsive QA, one owned Free/private PostgreSQL18 instance. Parameter changes were unsaved drafts only.
provenance: Native page actions and DOM geometry from Chromium; no intercepted requests or artificial latency. Temporary inline position trial was reverted in the same evaluation.
geometryProbe: async(page)=>page.evaluate(()=>{const title=[...document.querySelectorAll("h3")].find(e=>e.textContent==="Parameter overrides");const editor=title?.parentElement?.parentElement;const measure=e=>{if(!e)return null;const r=e.getBoundingClientRect(),s=getComputedStyle(e);return{tag:e.tagName,id:e.id,slot:e.getAttribute("data-slot"),className:typeof e.className==="string"?e.className:"",x:r.x,right:r.right,width:r.width,clientWidth:e.clientWidth,scrollWidth:e.scrollWidth,overflowX:s.overflowX,minWidth:s.minWidth,display:s.display}};const table=editor?.querySelector("table");const chain=[];for(let e=table;e;e=e.parentElement)chain.push(measure(e));return{at:new Date().toISOString(),viewport:{width:innerWidth,height:innerHeight,documentWidth:document.documentElement.scrollWidth},editor:measure(editor),table:measure(table),scroller:measure(table?.parentElement),chain,controls:editor?[...editor.querySelectorAll("input,button")].map(e=>({label:e.getAttribute("aria-label")||e.textContent,value:e instanceof HTMLInputElement?e.value:null,...measure(e)})):[]}})

request.query:
mutation CreateDatabase($name: String!, $databaseName: String, $databaseUser: String, $ownerId: String, $environmentId: String, $plan: String, $version: String, $diskSizeGB: Int, $public: Boolean) {
  createDatabase(
    name: $name
    databaseName: $databaseName
    databaseUser: $databaseUser
    ownerId: $ownerId
    environmentId: $environmentId
    plan: $plan
    version: $version
    diskSizeGB: $diskSizeGB
    public: $public
  ) {
    id
    name
    databaseName
    databaseUser
    plan
    status
    projectId
    environmentId
    __typename
  }
}
